newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan outward investment up 49 pct in Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan outward investment up 49 pct in Jan-Oct.

text.p: Taiwan's overseas investment jumped 49 percent in the first 10 months of 1996 from the same period a year earlier, the government's Investment Commission said on Wednesday.

Taiwanese companies poured US$1.609 billion into the United States, southeast Asia and elsewhere between January and October, up from $1.077 million in the same period in 1995, the commission said in a statement.
Financial and insurance investment overseas in the first 10 months totalled $661.81 million, followed by $203.04 million in electronic and electric industry, the statement said.
Foreign investment in Taiwan rose two percent over the same period to $1.9 billion, of which invsetment in the domestic electronic industry accounted for $638 million.
